name: deepseek-cli
description: Minimal CLI for calling DeepSeek's language models (pro/flash) via direct HTTP with SSE streaming

scripts.build: bun build src/index.ts --outfile ../../dist/deepseek-cli.js --target bun --minify --sourcemap && bun -e "import{existsSync,unlinkSync}from'fs';import{join}from'path';for(const f of['src/deepseek-cli.js','src/deepseek-cli.js.map'].map(p=>join(import.meta.dir,p)))if(existsSync(f))unlinkSync(f)"
